habitica-egg-hatcher/features/auto_retry: Hatching is verified against your real inventory, and unhatched pets are retried automatically (up to 3 attempts)
habitica-egg-hatcher/features/batch: Hatch many egg and potion combinations at once from a single matrix
habitica-egg-hatcher/features/privacy: Credentials stored only in your browser, sent directly to Habitica
habitica-egg-hatcher/features/skip_owned: Already-owned pets and invalid combinations are marked, so no egg or potion is wasted
habitica-egg-hatcher/how_to_use/step1: Find your API User ID and API Token on the Habitica Settings / Site Data page.
habitica-egg-hatcher/how_to_use/step2: Enter them in the settings card - they are saved in your browser and shared with the other Habitica tools.
habitica-egg-hatcher/how_to_use/step3: Click Load Inventory to fetch your eggs, potions and owned pets, then pick the combinations you want to hatch in the matrix.
habitica-egg-hatcher/how_to_use/step4: Click Hatch and confirm. Each pet consumes one egg and one hatching potion.
habitica-egg-hatcher/how_to_use/step5: Results appear right on the cells. Anything that was not hatched is retried automatically.
habitica-egg-hatcher/message/confirm_hat: This will hatch {count} pet(s), consuming {eggs} egg(s) and {potions} potion(s). Continue?
habitica-egg-hatcher/message/inventory_e: Load your inventory to see hatchable combinations. Your credentials are read directly from Habitica.
habitica-egg-hatcher/message/no_credenti: Please fill in your API User ID and API Token.
habitica-egg-hatcher/message/none_select: Please select at least one combination to hatch.
habitica-egg-hatcher/note: Batch hatch Habitica pets by combining eggs and hatching potions in a single clickable matrix.
